poll.source_locator: Memo: full five-candidate ballot Ricketts 46, Osborn 43 (leaners included); third parties 2/2/2 and Undecided 5 from Round 1 column of the Oct 22 trend memo
poll.notes: D slot = Dan Osborn (Independent); Democrats fielded no nominee (Burbank withdrew July 2026, party backs Osborn). n = 800 total (600 statewide + 200 NE-02 oversample, weighted down); MoE based on 600. Memo dated October 12, 2026. Head-to-head also reported: 49 / 46, undecided 6.

pollster.weighting_quote: Statewide results are weighted on all 800 interviews, with the oversample weighted down to NE-02's share of the state.
